checks.item: A1 F-0003 fix: GPU now keeps stick points across increments, but this is NOT what FEBio does; documentation and gate 1d call it 'the FEBio rule'
checks.evidence: FEBio: FESlidingElasticInterface::Update projects first (FESlidingElasticInterface.cpp:680 -> ProjectSurface overwrites data.m_rs with the current projection at :596-597 and :610-611) and only then, at m_niter == 0, InitSlidingSurface sets m_rsp = m_rs (:685-688, :136); Update is called from FESolidSolver2::PrepStep -> UpdateModel (FESolidSolver2.cpp:962, :1046). So FEBio's stick point at every increment start = current projection; m_rs = m_rsp while stuck (:881) only holds WITHIN an increment. Empirical: r0001 V02 (work/agents/verifier/v02_results_E10.json) FEBio creep 0.0151 mm per hold increment (0.075 mm / 5 increments, 0.302 mm / 20), twice the old GPU rule. Write-up: work/agents/verifier/v05_febio_stick_order.md. False claims: gpufe/contact.py:107-109, gpufe/gate1d_stick_memory.py:5-7 and its print label 'FEBio rule' (:71); F-0003 'evidence' cites :136 and :880-881 without the call order. Consequence: the GPU (new rule) is the physically correct Coulomb stick, FEBio is not; any gate that compares cage translation / ratcheting over holds or cycles with FEBio (r0001 proposal gate 4b) would fail the correct solver or push it back to FEBio's creep, and all real-friction FEBio runs of the study contain increment-dependent ratcheting (the main endpoint).
fix_options: Correct the docstrings and VERIFICATION.md: 'stick memory across increments (classical Coulomb return mapping, Wriggers 2006 Computational Contact Mechanics ch. 5); FEBio 4 re-anchors every increment (Update order) and creeps'
Gate 4: FEBio reference only for monotonic loading up to first gross slip; holds and cycles judged against the analytical requirement (zero creep below the limit) and increment-independence
Flag every FEBio real-friction run (old repo) as 'creep-contaminated' in the archive; never mix FEBio and GPU friction translations in one ranking

checks.item: A2 Newton line search: accepted state is inconsistent when all 6 trials fail (r0001 C2, not fixed)
checks.evidence: gpufe/newton.py:223-228: trial lengths a = 1, 0.5, ..., 0.03125 (ls_max 6, :30); the break 'a < 0.02' is never reached. If no trial lowers |g|, the last loop pass restores the rigid-body c, R (:227) and halves a to 0.015625, but x = xn (:233) keeps the node positions of the a = 0.03125 trial, including rigid-body nodes moved by _apply_rigid in _update (:188). Then ui = a du (:231) is half of the step actually applied to free nodes, so normu (:232) is 4x too small and the dtol test (:239) can declare convergence falsely; the residual g accepted is larger than before. stop_unconverged (:245) does not catch this because the iteration may still be flagged converged.
fix_options: On line-search failure: keep the state of the trial actually accepted (do not restore rb), use that a for ui; or reject the iteration, refactorise and retry; count it in info and fail the increment after 2 consecutive failures
Use FEBio's energy line search (FELineSearch, ui.R(s)) and its line-step check (FESolidSolver2.cpp:1119)

checks.item: A6 Gent locking: GPU clamps, FEBio does not; the clamp sits inside the design range of the compliant PLCL
checks.evidence: gpufe/mech.py:157 den = clamp(1 - (I1~-3)/Jm, min 1e-6) -> past locking the stress is a finite G/1e-6 and the autodiff tangent of the clamped branch is 0; FEBio FEGentMaterial.cpp:57 W1 = 0.5 G Jm / (Jm - I1 + 3) has no guard (diverges / changes sign -> FEBio fails). Jm = 0.7 was chosen to lock near 40 % uniaxial compression (l2_febio/h14_build_case.py:48), and 40 % is the allowed strain of compliant PLCL 50:50 during insertion (DECISIONS.md 2026-10-26). Hand computation (incompressible uniaxial, lambda 0.6): I1~ - 3 = 0.36 + 2/0.6 - 3 = 0.693 = 99 % of Jm. Gate 1 tested only 21 % of Jm (r0001 v03_gate1_coverage.json).
fix_options: Raise (mark the run invalid) when den < 1e-3 anywhere, instead of clamping

checks.item: A7 Formula transcription vs FEBio source
checks.evidence: Orthotropic: mech.py:147-148 = FEOrthoElastic.cpp:96-98, 116-121. Gent: mech.py:158 S~ = G Jm/(Jm - I1~ + 3) I = 2 W1 I with FEGentMaterial.cpp:57. Fiber exp-pow: mech.py:123-127 = FEFiberExpPow.cpp:73, 91 (lam0 = 1 only, see A5). Newton norms: newton.py:229-240 (normRi = g.g, normEi = |du.g|, normu <= dtol^2 normU, normE1 <= etol normEi) = FESolidSolver2.cpp:1070-1112. Coulomb stick trial and test: contact.py:162-167 = FESlidingElasticInterface.cpp:857-871 (sign convention flipped). Gate 1 agreement 1e-12 confirms neo-Hookean, Holmes-Mow, Gent, prestrain, ortho numerically. Differences that remain (by design, must be covered by gates 2-4): node-to-facet with master normal vs FEBio slave Gauss points with slave normal (r0001 C7); slip direction = direction to the anchor (contact.py:168) vs FEBio incremental slip direction SlipTangent (FESlidingElasticInterface.cpp:701-757) - equal for monotonic slip, differ after stick memory; FEBio checks missing in Newton: line-step minimum (FESolidSolver2.cpp:1119), energy divergence (:1124), augmentations; no step cutting (run stops instead, newton.py:245 - safe).

checks.item: A8 Slip -> stick transition forgets the elastic offset (bounded artefact)
checks.evidence: contact.py:111-114: a node that slipped is re-anchored at its current projection, so its tangential force restarts at 0 in the next increment and must be rebuilt by extra displacement ~ mu p / eps per slip-stick event (FEBio does the same). Hand estimate (eps = 10 E / 0.2 mm as in F-0003, p = 1 MPa, mu 0.3): hard PLCL E 400 -> 1.5e-5 mm, soft E 10 -> 6e-4 mm per event; unverified for the cage. Small against the 0.5 mm posterior limit but it is a ratchet near the friction limit.
fix_options: Return mapping: after slip set the anchor to x_slave + t_slip / k (tangential part), so the force at the limit is carried into the next increment

summary_zh:
第 2 輪驗證結論：暫停（HOLD），GPU 求解器的結果還不能用來排名或推進任何 cage 設計。

1. 可重現性：我重跑了第 1 關（材料公式的修補測試），六個案例全部通過，輸入檔與 FEBio 輸出逐位元相同；GPU 的誤差數字只在 10 的負 16 次方等級有差異（GPU 平行加總順序造成），屬正常。

2. 最嚴重的問題（關鍵）：紅隊的 F-0003 修正讓 GPU 程式在負荷增量之間保留「黏著參考點」，這在物理上是正確的庫侖摩擦。但程式說明與第 1d 關都寫成「這是 FEBio 的做法」，這是錯的。我讀了 FEBio 原始碼：FEBio 在每個增量開始時會先重新投影、再存成參考點，所以 FEBio 每個增量都會忘記黏著位置，在固定負荷下會一直慢慢滑動（我第 1 輪的測試量到每個增量約 0.015 毫米）。後果：之後的摩擦驗證（第 4 關）不能拿 FEBio 當持續負荷或循環負荷的標準答案；過去用 FEBio 跑的真實摩擦結果，滑移量被人為放大。

3. 其他主要問題：(a) 牛頓法求解器的步長搜尋在全部失敗時，會留下前後不一致的狀態，並少算位移，可能誤判為收斂（第 1 輪已提出，尚未修正）。(b) 實際使用的牛頓法求解器，在第 1b、1c 關仍沒有與 FEBio 比對的通過紀錄。(c) 第 2 關（完整脊椎節段）只有屈曲 1 個方向通過，另外 5 個方向在小面關節接觸時算出非數值；而且椎間盤與終板的黏合介面在每一步回報的力都是 0，原因未明。(d) FEBio 模型中小面關節使用的「增廣拉格朗日」接觸設定被 GPU 程式默默忽略。(e) 軟質 PLCL 使用的 Gent 材料在約 40% 壓縮時會「鎖死」，GPU 程式在此處把數值截斷而不報錯，FEBio 則會失敗；而 40% 正是植入時允許的上限。(f) 結果檔沒有記錄程式版本、設定、輸入檔雜湊值；作為參考答案的 FEBio 是本專案自行修改過的版本，修改內容與執行檔雜湊不在本儲存庫中。(g) 摩擦極限分析腳本在儲存庫拆分後路徑已失效；77 個以錯誤負荷曲線算出的結果檔沒有標記為無效；面的法向量與面積用的是變形前座標。

4. 公式核對：正交異向、Gent、纖維、牛頓收斂判準與 FEBio 原始碼一致（附行號）。

5. 我提出了第 2 到第 5 關的具體數字標準（例如第 2 關六個方向的旋轉角差異不超過 5% 或 0.1 度；第 4 關的持續負荷與循環負荷改以「低於摩擦極限時不得滑移」的解析要求為準，不再以 FEBio 為準），並提出 9 項變更請求。

限制：本輪無法執行我自己資料夾中的測試腳本（權限只允許執行 gpufe 內的驗證腳本），所以固定負荷下的滑移測試（V02）留到第 3 輪。
